result.text:
Southern Ice Works raises its costs 10%
What if: Product unit cost up 10% on 8 products supplied by Southern Ice Works.
- gross margin: 35.76% → 35.64%, down 0.12 points (exact: -0.116624 points)
- avg unit cost: 85.180 → 85.335 AUD, up 0.155 AUD (0.2%) (exact: 0.154643 AUD)
- total stock value at cost: 27424.50 → 27639.88 AUD, up 215.38 AUD (0.8%) (exact: 215.375 AUD)
Changed: Flake Ice 10kg unit cost 5.10 AUD → 5.61 AUD; Party Ice 5kg unit cost 3.80 AUD → 4.18 AUD; Gel Ice Pack 1kg unit cost 2.40 AUD → 2.64 AUD; Ice Brick 500g unit cost 1.80 AUD → 1.98 AUD; Crushed Ice 5kg unit cost 3.20 AUD → 3.52 AUD; Insulated Seafood Carton unit cost 6.75 AUD → 7.43 AUD; Block Ice 20kg unit cost 7.25 AUD → 7.98 AUD; Dry Ice 2kg unit cost 13.00 AUD → 14.30 AUD.
